answer: The help center shows two forms retired in 2026, and both changed on February 1, 2026. The notarized power of attorney form NW-POA-1 was replaced by NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically without a notary. In Georgia, though, a power of attorney still has to be notarized, including NW-POA-2. An NW-POA-1 signed before February 1, 2026 was accepted until June 30, 2026. The odometer disclosure statement NW-ODO-1 was replaced by NW-ODO-2.
